title: The 5 Most Expensive Houses in South Florida
igCaption:
The five priciest home sales ever recorded in South Florida, from Shaq's old Star Island estate to Larry Ellison's $173M Gemini in Manalapan.

Which one would you live in?

Sources: The Real Deal, Bloomberg, Palm Beach Daily News, Forbes, Robb Report

#realestate #palmbeach #miami #southflorida

scenes.text: These are the five most expensive houses in South Florida, and number one sold for one hundred seventy-three million dollars.
scenes.caption: These are the 5 most expensive houses in South Florida… and #1 sold for $173 MILLION.

scenes.text: Number five is twenty-six Star Island Drive in Miami Beach. Developer Vlad Doronin bought it from Shaquille O'Neal in two thousand nine for sixteen million dollars. In twenty twenty-five he sold it for one hundred twenty million, a county record at the time.
scenes.caption: #5 is 26 Star Island Drive in Miami Beach. Developer Vlad Doronin bought it from Shaquille O'Neal in 2009 for $16 million. In 2025 he sold it for $120 million, a county record at the time.

scenes.text: Number four sits on its own private island. Tarpon Island in Palm Beach, with a twenty-eight thousand six hundred square foot house, sold in May twenty twenty-four for one hundred fifty-two million dollars, a record for a lakefront home.
scenes.caption: #4 sits on its own private island. Tarpon Island in Palm Beach, with a 28,600 sq ft house, sold in May 2024 for $152 million, a record for a lakefront home.

scenes.text: Number three is five eighty-nine North County Road, a one point six acre oceanfront estate in Palm Beach. Car dealer Michael Cantanucci bought it in twenty twenty-three for a price reported at about one hundred seventy million dollars.
scenes.caption: #3 is 589 North County Road, a 1.6-acre oceanfront estate in Palm Beach. Car dealer Michael Cantanucci bought it in 2023 for a price reported at about $170 million.

scenes.text: Number two belongs to Mark Zuckerberg. In March twenty twenty-six he and Priscilla Chan paid one hundred seventy million dollars for a house still under construction on Indian Creek Island. It was listed at two hundred million, and it's now the Miami-Dade record.
scenes.caption: #2 belongs to Mark Zuckerberg. In March 2026 he and Priscilla Chan paid $170 million for a house still under construction on Indian Creek Island. It was listed at $200 million, and it's now the Miami-Dade record.

scenes.text: And number one is Gemini in Manalapan, an estate that runs from the ocean to the lake. Jim Clark bought it for ninety-four point two million. About fifteen months later, in June twenty twenty-two, Larry Ellison paid one hundred seventy-three million, the most ever paid for a home in Florida at the time.
scenes.caption: And #1 is Gemini in Manalapan, an estate that runs from the ocean to the lake. Jim Clark bought it for $94.2 million. About 15 months later, in June 2022, Larry Ellison paid $173 million, the most ever paid for a home in Florida at the time.
